title: Support Aider (CONVENTIONS.md + .aider.conf.yml)
description:
Target: Aider conventions + config.

Conventions:
- Conventions file: `CONVENTIONS.md`
- Config: `.aider.conf.yml` supports `read: CONVENTIONS.md` (and lists)

Outline:
- Create or append `CONVENTIONS.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Optionally update `.aider.conf.yml` to ensure conventions are always loaded (e.g., `read: CONVENTIONS.md`)
- Keep YAML edits safe (preserve existing keys; no duplicates)
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates/updates `CONVENTIONS.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- (If enabled) updates `.aider.conf.yml` to load conventions

title: Core: idempotent snippet insertion
description:
Create shared utilities for safe, repeatable edits to agent rule files.

Outline:
- Define canonical Iteration Deck snippet + begin/end markers
- Append when missing; update in-place if marker exists
- Normalize line endings and preserve existing content
- Emit a structured summary of changes for the CLI
acceptance_criteria:
- Re-running init does not duplicate content
- Existing user content is preserved
- All writes are atomic (temp + rename)
- No runtime impact: utilities are only invoked by `init` (no new import side effects)

title: Init CLI: prompt for agent tools (multi-select)
description:
Build the interactive init flow.

Outline:
- Add `iteration-deck init` (or `npx iteration-deck init`) entrypoint
- Prompt user with a multi-select list of supported agentic tools
- Execute selected integrations in one run
- Print a summary of files written/updated
acceptance_criteria:
- Shows a multi-select list of supported agents
- Returns a deterministic list of chosen agents
- Exits non-zero on write failures with actionable errors
- CLI is implemented as a separate `bin` entry; does not change library `main`/`exports` behavior

title: Support Windsurf (.windsurf/rules)
description:
Target: Windsurf (Cascade) workspace rules.

Conventions:
- Workspace rules: `.windsurf/rules/*.md`
- Also supports directory-scoped `AGENTS.md`/`agents.md`

Outline:
- Create `.windsurf/rules/iteration-deck.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Ensure directory exists
- (Optional) Offer AGENTS.md path as an alternative integration choice
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates `.windsurf/rules/iteration-deck.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Rule file is created once

title: Support Amazon Kiro (.kiro/steering)
description:
Target: Amazon Kiro workspace steering files.

Conventions:
- Workspace steering: `.kiro/steering/*.md`
- Global steering: `~/.kiro/steering/*.md`
- Also supports `AGENTS.md` in workspace root

Outline:
- Ensure `.kiro/steering/` exists
- Create `.kiro/steering/iteration-deck.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- (Optional) add inclusion frontmatter if Kiro supports it for steering files
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates `.kiro/steering/iteration-deck.md`
- Does not touch global (~) locations

title: Support Google Antigravity (.agent/rules)
description:
Target: Google Antigravity workspace rules.

Conventions:
- Workspace rules: `.agent/rules/*.md`
- Global rules: `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md` (out of scope for init)
- Rules can reference other files via `@filename`

Outline:
- Ensure `.agent/rules/` exists
- Create `.agent/rules/iteration-deck.md`
- Include an `@node_modules/iteration-deck/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md` reference (plus a plain-text fallback link)
- Leave activation mode to defaults/UI unless file metadata is documented
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates `.agent/rules/iteration-deck.md` with Iteration Deck guidance
- Uses `@` reference syntax when available

title: Init script: inject Iteration Deck agent rules
description: Build an init CLI that updates project-level agent instruction files for selected tools, pointing them at Iteration Deck docs shipped in the NPM module.
acceptance_criteria:
- Running `npx iteration-deck init` prompts for agent tool(s) (multi-select)
- Writes/updates the correct rules file(s) per selected tool
- Adds an Iteration Deck snippet pointing to `node_modules/iteration-deck/...`
- Idempotent: re-running does not duplicate injected content
- Safe: preserves existing user instructions
- No interference: library `main`/`exports` behavior unchanged; CLI is a separate `bin` entry
- No new side effects on normal `import`/usage

title: Support Cursor (.cursor/rules + legacy .cursorrules)
description:
Target: Cursor Project Rules.

Conventions:
- Preferred: `.cursor/rules/<rule-name>/RULE.md` (folder-per-rule)
- Legacy: `.cursorrules` (root) and `.mdc` rules (still supported)

Outline:
- Create `.cursor/rules/iteration-deck/RULE.md` with Iteration Deck guidance + module-docs link
- If `.cursorrules` exists (legacy), append a minimal pointer instead of creating folders (or do both with opt-in)
- Keep changes additive + idempotent
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates/updates Cursor rules without overwriting user rules
- Adds Iteration Deck pointer exactly once

title: Support GitHub Copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md)
description:
Target: GitHub Copilot repository custom instructions.

Convention:
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`

Outline:
- Ensure `.github/` exists
- Create or append to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` with Iteration Deck snippet
- If `copilot-instructions.md` exists at repo root, optionally update it too (document precedence)

title: Support OpenAI Codex CLI (AGENTS.md)
description:
Target: Codex CLI / AGENTS.md convention.

Convention:
- `AGENTS.md` (root + directory-scoped)

Outline:
- Create or append to root `AGENTS.md` with an Iteration Deck section
- Use markers so repeated runs update in place
- Keep snippet short and point at `node_modules/iteration-deck/...`
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates/updates `AGENTS.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Does not duplicate on rerun

title: Support JetBrains Junie (.junie/guidelines.md)
description:
Target: JetBrains Junie project guidelines.

Conventions:
- Default guidelines path: `.junie/guidelines.md` in project root
- Can also use `AGENTS.md` (configurable)

Outline:
- Ensure `.junie/` exists
- Create or append `.junie/guidelines.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Keep insertion idempotent + non-destructive
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates/updates `.junie/guidelines.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Preserves existing guidelines

title: Docs: list supported agents + files
description:
Document what `init` supports and what files it writes/updates for each tool.

Outline:
- Add a table mapping: tool -> file/dir -> snippet strategy
- Include notes about deprecated/legacy paths (e.g., `.cursorrules`)
- Add troubleshooting section (how to undo, where markers live)
acceptance_criteria:
- README (or docs page) lists supported tools and their file locations
- Docs include the non-interference guarantee (CLI `bin` is separate; library entrypoints unchanged)

title: Support Claude Code (CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules)
description:
Target: Anthropic Claude Code project memory.

Conventions:
- Project memory: `./CLAUDE.md` or `./.claude/CLAUDE.md`
- Modular rules: `./.claude/rules/*.md`
- Supports `@path/to/import` from CLAUDE.md

Outline:
- Prefer updating `./.claude/CLAUDE.md` if it exists, else `./CLAUDE.md`
- Append an Iteration Deck section that imports module docs, e.g. `@node_modules/iteration-deck/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md`
- Ensure idempotency via markers (update if already present)
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates/updates CLAUDE memory with Iteration Deck snippet
- Uses Claude import syntax for module docs
- Re-running does not duplicate

title: Support Continue (.continue/rules)
description:
Target: Continue local rules.

Convention:
- `.continue/rules/*`

Outline:
- Ensure `.continue/rules/` exists
- Create `.continue/rules/iteration-deck.md` with Iteration Deck pointer
- Keep file short + additive
acceptance_criteria:
- Creates `.continue/rules/iteration-deck.md`
- Leaves existing Continue config untouched

title: Support Cline (.clinerules / .clinerules/)
description:
Target: Cline workspace rules.

Conventions:
- Single file: `.clinerules` (root)
- Folder system: `.clinerules/` (all markdown combined)
- Also supports `AGENTS.md` fallback

Outline:
- If `.clinerules/` exists, add `iteration-deck.md` inside
- Else create/append `.clinerules` at repo root
- Idempotent markers; do not stomp existing rules
acceptance_criteria:
- Adds Iteration Deck guidance to Cline rules (file or folder)
- Idempotent across repeated runs
